prompt.en: How many provinces and how many territories does Canada have?
prompt.fr: Combien de provinces et combien de territoires le Canada compte-t-il?

explanation.en: Canada is made up of ten provinces and three territories. Each one has its own capital city, and you should know the capital of the place where you live.
explanation.fr: Le Canada est composé de dix provinces et de trois territoires. Chacun a sa propre capitale, et vous devriez connaître celle de l'endroit où vous habitez.

source.quote: Canada has ten provinces and three territories. Each province and territory has its own capital city.
